name: mnemo-cards
description: AI-powered spaced repetition for students: turn lecture slides into flashcards and build shared decks with your class.

scripts.build:engine: emcmake cmake -S engine -B engine/build-wasm -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build engine/build-wasm
scripts.test:engine: cmake -S engine -B engine/build && cmake --build engine/build && ctest --test-dir engine/build --output-on-failure
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run build:engine && npm run test:app
